page.title: UT on rollers
page.hint: Dryer thicknesses, press journals, results summary and report per group. States come from the UT norma (Settings → Normas).
page.noOrdersHint: Create one in Services with the “NDT · UT on rollers” technique.
page.noGroupsHint: Create a train of kind “Rollers” in Plant structure and add its rollers below.

sheet.title: Thicknesses · {{order}}
sheet.hint: Thicknesses in mm, measured with a probe. An inaccessible roller has no values: it counts in its own box of the summary.

rollers.title: Add rollers
rollers.hint: Creates a group's rollers, each with its six points. Existing ones are skipped; the plan caps the total.

journal.hint: Per roller: diameter, external and total length in mm, access and state. The state writes itself from access and findings, or you write it.
journal.statePlaceholder: Filled automatically; type to change it
journal.noFindings: No cracks on the roller journal.

results.title: Results summary
results.hint: Every group and side of the order, with its findings. Built from the findings recorded on the journals.
results.empty: No journals recorded in this order yet.

report.title: Conclusions and recommendations
report.hint: What the report says about this group in this order.
report.planHint: The group's plan or schema that goes with the report.
report.photosHint: Photos of the group in this order, with their note.
report.caption: Photo note
